mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (title, publisher_id, start_time, end_time, location, description, status, approval_status, type_id, max_participants, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{publisherId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{description}, #{status}, #{approvalStatus}, #{typeId}, #{maxParticipants}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity WHERE approval_status = 'pending' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE approval_status = #{approvalStatus} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO activity (title, publisher_id, start_time, end_time, location, description, status, approval_status, type_id, max_participants, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.title}, #{item.publisherId}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.location}, #{item.description}, #{item.status}, #{item.approvalStatus}, #{item.typeId}, #{item.maxParticipants}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, start_time, publisher_id FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'published' AND start_time BETWEEN #{now} AND #{oneHourLater}
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET status = 'ended' WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'published' AND end_time < #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'published' AND end_time < #{now}
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'published' AND approval_status = 'approved' AND end_time < #{currentTime} ORDER BY end_time ASC
SELECT * FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND approval_status = 'pending' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT a.id as activityId, a.title, a.status, a.start_time as startTime, a.location, at.name as activityType, COUNT(ar.id) as registrationCount, a.view_count as viewCount FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_type at ON a.type_id = at.id LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON a.id = ar.activity_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY registrationCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id as activityId, a.title, a.status, a.start_time as startTime, a.location, at.name as activityType, COUNT(ac.id) as collectionCount, a.view_count as viewCount FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_type at ON a.type_id = at.id LEFT JOIN activity_collect ac ON a.id = ac.activity_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY collectionCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id as activityId, a.title, a.status, a.start_time as startTime, a.location, at.name as activityType, a.view_count as viewCount FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_type at ON a.type_id = at.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT AVG(registration_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ar.id) as registration_count FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON a.id = ar.activity_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY a.id ) as counts
SELECT AVG(view_count) FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT at.name as `key`, COUNT(a.id) as `value` FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_type at ON a.type_id = at.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY a.type_id, at.name
SELECT status as `key`, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status
SELECT approval_status as `key`, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY approval_status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') as label, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) as label, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) BETWEEN #{startWeek} AND #{endWeek} GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as label, COUNT(*) as `value` FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY label ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE status = 'confirmed'
